tape: All 14 screens ran at defaults; the CSP screen returned 20 setups.
13 of the 20 CSP names grade downtrend, 6 mixed, 1 uptrend (NTSK). 16 of 20 strikes sit under the 200 SMA.
12 of 20 are up on the week, so a lot of this premium is being sold into a bounce inside a downtrend.
IV rank came back on only 2 of 20 (PL 50.1, APLD 50.4). Everything else is graded on IV level and chart, not rank. Quotes: 19 firm, 1 wide.
Five correlation clusters: RIOT+MARA+WULF+APLD, WOLF+NVTS, AXTI+SMCI, PENG+FPS, ONDS+OKLO+PL.
Gamma scan: 16 of 25 names in positive gamma, 9 negative, all walls on the 11/20 expiry.
